1.12.2.1.10.3:
Additions:
  Patcher will now send a notification if any loaded mod has an update available. As usual, mods can be individually disabled in Forge's configs
Fixes:
  Fixed the update notification's failure notification crashing the game
1.12.2.1.10.2:
Additions:
  Added option to make button text white on hover instead of yellow, like in 1.14+
Fixes:
  Fixed compatibility with the 5zig mod
1.12.2.1.10.1:
Additions:
  Backported the 1.14 sign edit GUI to 1.12.2 (makes the GUI use a text field for text editing)
  Added option to have an unlimited entity render distance
Fixes:
  Fixed Alternate Text Shadow and Disable Text Shadow making text shift around the cursor in text fields
Misc:
  Updated UniversalCraft and Elementa to their latest versions
1.12.2.1.10.0:
Additions:
  Added option to change the pumpkin overlay opacity
  Added options to change the maximum FPS when the window is minimized
  Added the Chat Peek keybind back, this is yet another feature that got moved into Essential
  Added option to play a sound on game startup
  Added options to disable the rendering of falling blocks and paintings
  Made entity culling automatically disable itself if the EntityCulling mod is loaded
Fixes:
  Fixed "Remove Inverted Colors from Crosshair" not working
  The duplicate mods json is now fetched in another thread, improving startup performance
  Micro optimization to entity culling
Misc:
  Updated UniversalCraft and Elementa to their latest versions, should fix the config sliders being laggy among other things
1.12.2.1.9.2:
Fixes:
  Fixed custom FPS limit and unfocused FPS not working
  Fixed extended chat history not working as this was an Essential feature
1.12.2.1.9.1:
Additions:
  Changed main menu to render at the configured FPS instead of a hardcoded 30. Fixes the choppy config GUI
Fixes:
  Fixed mod missing version metadata, breaking the update checker
1.12.2.1.9.0:
NOTE: Essential is no longer required as a dependency.
You can uninstall it if you don't want it (delete the "essential" folder in the Minecraft folder). If it comes back, another mod probably depends on it.
This should result in improved loading times and better performance.
Additions:
  Added update checking. Can be disabled in Forge's settings
  Added option to disable the effects of night vision
  Added DE QWERTZ keyboard layout support on Linux
Fixes:
  Fixed Compact Chat scrolling the messages when a new message is compacted
  Fixed screenshots getting deleted if making them favorite fails
Misc:
  You can now open the configuration GUI from the mod list
  The startup time notification is now more accurate
  Changed to query the GitHub repository for mod data instead of sk1er.club
1.12.2.1.8.9:
Fixes:
  Resolve not being able to launch the game
Misc:
  Change "safe chat clicks history" to not depend on "safe chat clicks"
1.12.2.1.8.8:
Additions:
  Add cactus to 1.14+ crop hitboxes
  Add option to remove vertical view bobbing
Fixes:
  Resolve achievement menu breaking with remove container background
  Resolve resource pack folder sometimes not opening on windows
  Resolve not being able to open chests with a block 2 blocks above it
  Resolve image preview breaking on Imgur links
Misc:
  Change "inventoryscale" command to be hidden from autocomplete (this command was moved to "/patcher invscale")
  Fixed patcher not working in dev environments
